title: Clarence Desdunes, Dub Pier band, New York, Celestin and Bunk Johnson
summary: He recounts later jobs with Desdunes, Piron, going to New York, rejoining Celestin until his stroke, and meeting the interviewers in New York with Bunk Johnson; Gene Williams is recalled.
